sets.title: Double Negation Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct negative pronoun and remember double negation

items.prompt: _____ не знает, где он. (Nobody knows where he is.)
items.hint: Nobody = никто. Don't forget не before the verb.
items.explanation: Double negation: Никто не знает. Both никто and не are required.

items.prompt: Я _____ не видел сегодня. (I haven't seen anything today.)
items.explanation: Ничего не видел: double negation. Ничего (gen/acc) is more common than ничто (nom).

items.prompt: Она _____ не ходит по вечерам. (She doesn't go anywhere in the evenings.)
items.promptEnglish: She doesn't go anywhere in the evenings.
items.explanation: Никуда не ходит: she doesn't go anywhere. Куда (where to) becomes никуда.

items.prompt: Мы _____ не были в этом ресторане. (We've never been to this restaurant.)
items.promptEnglish: We have never been to this restaurant.
items.explanation: Никогда не были: double negation. Never been.

items.prompt: В комнате _____ не было. (There was nobody in the room.)
items.promptEnglish: There was nobody in the room.
items.explanation: After не было, use genitive: никого не было (nobody was there).

items.prompt: Он _____ не нашёл. (He didn't find anything.)
items.explanation: Ничего не нашёл: didn't find anything. Double negation required.

items.prompt: Я _____ не могу помочь. Это невозможно. (I can't help in any way.)
items.promptEnglish: I can't help at all. It's impossible.
items.hint: In no way / no how = никак.
items.explanation: Никак не могу: I can't in any way. Никак = no way/no how.

minimalPairs.explanation: Nobody = Никто не (double negation). Кто-то = someone (positive).

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ слышу. (I hear something / I don't hear anything)
minimalPairs.explanation: Nothing: ничего не слышу. Что-то слышу = I hear something.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ ездил летом. (He went somewhere / He didn't go anywhere)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He didn't go anywhere in summer.
minimalPairs.explanation: Nowhere: никуда не ездил. Куда-то ездил = he went somewhere.

minimalPairs.context: Мы _____ видели этот фильм. (We saw it once / We've never seen it)
minimalPairs.explanation: Never: никогда не видели. Когда-то видели = once saw it.

sets.title: Negative Forms
sets.description: Sort question words to their negative forms and fill blanks
sets.descriptionRussian: Сопоставьте вопросы с отрицаниями и заполните пропуски

blanks: Ему _____ не интересно. (He's not interested in anything.)
Я _____ не могу найти свои очки! (I can't find my glasses anywhere!)
Она _____ не опаздывает. (She is never late.)
Там _____ не было. (There was nobody there.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: ничего = nothing, нигде = nowhere, никогда = never, никого = nobody (gen)
hints: Nobody was there = никого (genitive after не было).
explanations: Ничего не интересно: nothing is interesting to him.
Нигде не могу найти: can't find anywhere (location).
Никогда не опаздывает: she never is late.
Никого не было: nobody was there (genitive with не было).

translation.hint: Nobody = никто + не before verb. Called me = мне звонил.

translation.english: She has never been to Paris.
translation.answer: Она никогда не была в Париже.
translation.hint: Never = никогда + не. Been to = была в + prepositional.

sets.title: Preposition Splits
sets.description: Practice negative pronouns splitting with prepositions

items.prompt: Мне не _____ поговорить. (I have nobody to talk to.)
items.promptEnglish: I have nobody to talk to.
items.hint: Pattern: не + preposition + кем. The full form is 'не с кем.'
items.explanation: With prepositions, ни separates: не с кем (nobody to talk with). Full: мне не с кем поговорить.

items.prompt: Ей не _____ пойти. (She has nowhere to go.)
items.promptEnglish: She has nowhere to go (no destination).
items.hint: Pattern: не + куда = 'nowhere to go.' No preposition needed here.
items.explanation: Не куда пойти = nowhere to go (direction). When не is the main negation, куда loses ни-.

items.prompt: У неё нет _____ друзей. (She has no friends at all.)
items.hint: None at all = никакой (declined). Genitive plural = никаких.
items.explanation: Нет никаких друзей: no friends whatsoever. Никакой (no kind of) in genitive plural.

items.prompt: Он _____ не разговаривает на работе. (He doesn't talk to anyone at work.)
items.promptEnglish: He doesn't talk to anyone at work.
items.hint: With nobody = ни с кем (preposition splits ни from кем).
items.explanation: Preposition goes between ни and кем: ни с кем не разговаривает.

items.prompt: Я _____ не думаю. (I'm not thinking about anything.)
items.hint: About nothing = ни о чём (preposition splits ни).
items.explanation: Думать о + prepositional: ни о чём не думаю.

items.prompt: Она _____ не зависит. (She doesn't depend on anyone.)
items.hint: From/on nobody = ни от кого (preposition inside).
items.explanation: Зависеть от + genitive: ни от кого не зависит.

errorCorrection.hint: Double negation: negative pronoun requires не before the verb.
errorCorrection.explanation: Russian requires double negation: Никто НЕ знает. Without не, the sentence is grammatically wrong.

errorCorrection.hint: Preposition goes BETWEEN ни and кем.
errorCorrection.explanation: Prepositions split ни-: ни с кем (not *с никем).

errorCorrection.hint: Preposition goes between ни and чём.
errorCorrection.explanation: Prepositions split ни-: ни о чём (not *о ничём).
Direction uses никуда (not нигде which is location): никуда не хочу идти.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All negative pronouns including preposition splits

items.prompt: В этой деревне _____ не происходит. (Nothing ever happens in this village.)
items.promptEnglish: Nothing ever happens in this village.
items.hint: Nothing ever = two negative words. Both are fine together in Russian.
items.explanation: Russian allows stacking negatives: ничего никогда не происходит.

items.prompt: Мне не _____ было жить, когда я приехал. (I had nowhere to live when I arrived.)
items.promptEnglish: I had nowhere to live when I arrived.
items.hint: Не + где = nowhere to live (location). The не is already there.
items.explanation: Не где жить = nowhere to live. In this construction, не replaces ни-.

items.prompt: Мы _____ не довольны. (We are not satisfied with anything.)
items.promptEnglish: We are not satisfied with anything.
items.explanation: Довольны + instrumental: ничем не довольны (not satisfied with anything).

items.prompt: Он _____ не просил о помощи. (He never asked anyone for help.)
items.promptEnglish: He never asked anyone for help.
items.hint: Never + from nobody. Просить у кого = ask someone. Both negatives stack.
items.explanation: Stacked negatives: никогда ни у кого не просил. Never asked anyone.

items.prompt: Этот магазин _____ не нужен. (Nobody needs this store.)
items.explanation: Нужен + dative: никому не нужен (needed by nobody).

items.prompt: Which is correct for 'I have nobody to go with'?
items.promptEnglish: I have nobody to go with.
options: Мне ни с кем не пойти.
items.hint: не + prep + кем pattern for 'nobody to do X with.'
items.explanation: Мне не с кем пойти = I have nobody to go with. The не...кем construction with preposition inside.

blanks: Там _____ не было интересного. (There was nothing interesting there.)
Я _____ не жалею. (I don't regret anything.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: ничего (genitive) vs ни о чём (prepositional with о)
hints: Жалеть о + prepositional: ни о чём.
explanations: Не было + genitive: ничего не было (nothing was there).
Жалеть о + prepositional: ни о чём не жалею (don't regret anything).
